items.title: Implement review loop data model and storage
items.context: Add the minimal story-scoped review loop record model from Lattice-Review-reflection-loop.md: start, iteration, close, status, trigger refs, rollback/material hashes, reflection reason, policy decision reason, and latest-record state derivation. Reuse existing StoryStore/process artifact patterns; do not introduce a new external service.
items.userSees: 用户运行 `lattice review_loop_status --storyId=B-xxxx --json` 后看到 `records`、`latest.status` 和 `active` 字段来自 story-scoped review-loops artifact。

happy.desc: Starting a loop persists a story-scoped start record with loopId, trigger refs, rollbackRef, materialHash, status=open, and actor.

edge.desc: Missing trigger refs or missing storyId is rejected with a clear CLI/schema error and does not write review-loops state.

adversarial.desc: Reflection/reusableLearning fields are stored as context only and are not exposed as review pass or validation gate evidence.

verificationEvidence.note: review-loop-smoke 37/37 passed; start records, latest status derivation, JSONL storage, and handler status projection cover persisted story-scoped loop state.
Smoke covers empty trigger rejection and strict malformed review-loops.jsonl parsing, proving invalid input does not silently write usable loop state.
Smoke asserts reusableLearning remains reflection context only and is not promoted to top-level evidence, review pass, validation, or authority fields.

items.title: Expose minimal review_loop CLI surface
items.context: Add review_loop_start, review_loop_iteration_add, review_loop_status, review_loop_close, and review_loop_policy_show as recording/status commands only. They must not execute agents, spawn hosts, auto-DONE, auto-merge, or claim authority.
items.userSees: 用户运行 `lattice help | grep review_loop` 能看到 `review_loop_start`、`review_loop_iteration_add`、`review_loop_status`、`review_loop_close`、`review_loop_policy_show` 五个命令。

happy.desc: All five review_loop commands are registered, have CLI schemas/help, and return text/json without spawning hosts or executing agents.

edge.desc: Mutating commands are story-scoped metadata writes and enforce valid phases/ownership through command policy.

adversarial.desc: No command writes productionDone, authorityChanged, receiptVerified, receiptRefs, or any authority receipt field.

verificationEvidence.command: node packages/main/dist/cli.js review_loop_start --help && node packages/main/dist/cli.js review_loop_status --help && node packages/main/dist/cli.js review_loop_close --help
verificationEvidence.note: CLI help exists for review_loop commands and describes recording/read-only behavior without host execution.
Phase probe showed start/iteration_add/close are REVIEW-only, while status/policy_show are available in all phases.
Smoke asserts no productionDone, authorityChanged, receiptVerified, or receiptRefs fields exist on review loop records.

items.title: Integrate active loop blocking with REVIEW gate and status surfaces
items.context: REVIEW to TEST must block while latest ReviewLoopRecord.status is open. A resolved close may only unblock the loop gate when trigger refs are resolved or superseded by fresh evidence at the current material hash; blocked/escalated close does not unblock underlying finding/bug/scope/validation gates.
items.userSees: 当 REVIEW 阶段存在 open loop 时，用户运行 `lattice story_advance --storyId=B-xxxx --phase=TEST` 会看到 `Cannot enter TEST` 和 active review loop 的 loopId/decision/nextAction。

happy.desc: An open latest ReviewLoopRecord blocks REVIEW->TEST and status/session output surfaces loopId, decision, and nextAction.

edge.desc: A resolved close only clears the loop gate when materialHash is current and trigger refs are resolved or superseded; normal reviewer/finding/validation gates still apply.

adversarial.desc: Blocked or escalated close records do not unblock REVIEW by themselves and cannot mask an open finding, bug, scope violation, or validation failure.

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke covers open loop blocking runReviewLoopGate and getGuardFailureReason with loopId, decision, and nextAction in the TEST blocker message.
Smoke covers resolved close invariants: resolved close requires resolved/superseding evidence refs and a current materialHash before handler acceptance.
Smoke confirms blocked/escalated close records clear only the loop gate and do not create review pass, validation, production, or authority fields; other lifecycle gates remain separate.

items.title: Add focused contract and smoke tests
items.context: Cover policy priority, open-loop REVIEW gate blocking, close invariants, JSON command shape, host-neutral no-authority behavior, and command registry/process-fact integration. Keep tests scoped to executable correctness only.
items.userSees: 用户运行 `npm --prefix packages/main run test:review-loop-smoke` 和 `node scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs` 后看到 review loop smoke 与 process fact contract 均通过。

happy.desc: Smoke test covers start, iteration, status, close, and policy priority behavior with deterministic assertions.

edge.desc: Contract verification fails if a review_loop L4 command lacks command policy, process fact level, artifact registry, or CLI schema entry.

adversarial.desc: Tests prove review_loop commands do not execute hosts, perform rollback, auto-merge, auto-DONE, or set authority receipt fields.

verificationEvidence.command: npm run build && npm --prefix packages/main run test:review-loop-smoke
verificationEvidence.note: Build passed and review-loop-smoke reported 37 passed, 0 failed across policy helpers, gate behavior, status JSON, duplicate loopId, and no-authority assertions.

Process fact contract output registered review_loop_start/iteration_add/close as L4 gate-evidence and review_loop_status/policy_show as L0; remaining script failure was pre-existing autopilot_* and release_approve_push drift, with no review_loop failure entries.
Smoke proves review_loop records do not execute hosts, perform rollback, auto-merge, auto-DONE, or set authority/receipt fields; rollback and handoff remain hints only.

items.title: Run multi-host implementation review and record evidence
items.context: Use two Claude CLI review lanes and Codex CLI review to inspect the implementation. Accept only real correctness issues; record verificationEvidence and keep advisory optimization out of scope.
items.userSees: 用户在最终汇报里看到 `Claude host review: no must-fix`、`Codex host review: no must-fix` 或具体 accepted must-fix 列表，并看到对应 verificationEvidence refs。

happy.desc: Two Claude CLI lanes and one Codex CLI lane review the implementation and return no unresolved must-fix correctness issues.

edge.desc: If a host reports advisory-only optimization, it is recorded as advisory and not implemented unless tied to executable correctness.

adversarial.desc: If hosts disagree, the main agent records the disagreement and accepts only source-grounded correctness findings, not preference changes.

verificationEvidence.command: Claude CLI host A + Claude CLI host B + Codex CLI focused re-audit
verificationEvidence.note: Two Claude CLI lanes and one Codex CLI lane performed read-only review. Final re-audit PASS from all three; no unresolved must-fix correctness issue remained.

verificationEvidence.command: Codex CLI first audit and follow-up fix review
verificationEvidence.note: Codex reported three real correctness findings: resolved close invariant, duplicate explicit loopId/status inconsistency, and --outcome hint drift. All were fixed, tested, and Codex re-audit returned PASS.
Advisory-only notes were not implemented unless tied to source-grounded correctness. The accepted changes were limited to executable correctness and logic consistency.
